overview.description: The ETRACS MarketVector Business Development Companies Liquid Index ETN (BDCZ) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund tracks an index of at least 25 companies invested in the initial growth stages of small firms. BDCZ was launched on Oct 8, 2015 and is issued by ETRACS.
